decisions.reason: The reviewed occurrences resolve as the personal title/name 廣燈禪師 or the bibliographic title 天聖廣燈錄, not an independently deployed Chan expression.
The full cases use the string only as the title/citation 嘉泰普燈錄; no lexical Chan deployment survives the title boundary.
Six current-byte occurrences support the corpus-attested split between a horse’s foot and the fixed 露出馬腳 giveaway idiom, with three independent works per sense.
Four independent full cases use heel-following as an explicit rebuke for derivative bodily, verbal, or conceptual movement.
The reviewed letters and instructions retain the ordinary goods/material-profit sense, commonly coordinated with 聲色 or 名利; no distinct Chan lexical job is evidenced.
